answer: Time is the tax no farm can dodge: 24 minutes per proof, 12864 minutes for 536, due every single epoch. Checking costs almost nothing, which is why the check can run on every applicant. Give the epoch a spine: Brewer yeast jar proof brewed at the hop garden, proved by each yeast jar is a season of logged brew readings plus a signed brew record, checked by strangers. Behind every ripple there is an office, behind every cedar a ledger, behind every terrace a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three.
